name: Chat system
ownerWords:
keep monitoring all the usage patterns of the Chat feature for that day, and periodically refine the framework so same stupid errors don't happen again.
now, this is a common patter, i want you to deep-research what to do. i want it to be owned by Chat though, maybe in a Cron/heartbeat tab within it with semantic goal defined
goal: Every duty in every chat meets every target on its last run (c75: an off-target duty is never ok), and no duty stays red for 3 runs without a live fix job. No correction is given twice and no chat turn fails on sieun-pi code. 100% and 0 are the owner's words (c75, "same stupid errors don't happen again").

metrics.label: Duties in all chats that are green
Duties that missed 3 runs in a row with no live fix job
Chat turns failed by sieun-pi code

onMiss: Each missed metric gets a fix this run, run after run, until green (c75); a report alone does not count. stuck_duties: for each line, message the chat that owns the duty with the duty name, the missed metric, its value and target, and ask it to start a root-fix job with a new approach, since 3 runs did not move it. Next run, check each one has a live fix job (a fixes entry with live true, or an open step linked <dutyId>/<metricKey> whose job works); if not, message the chat again with what is missing. repeat_corrections: make agents follow the rule with the smallest fix, a brief, skill or prompt line first and a code gate only when measured repeats show the text did not hold, named in the fix (c81), and record it with correction_add id. sieun_pi_breaks: reproduce the error, fix it with a test, release. Other precheck numbers (steps_moving_pct, end_state_pct, stuck_step_hours) are context.
